html:
Arjunaa Academy for Achievers (AAA) is a trusted institution for coaching classes, enabling students to excel in a variety of competitive exams such as JEE (Main + Advanced), Pre-Medical (NEET-UG), KVPY, Pre-Nurture & Career Foundation (Class VIII to X, NTSE & Olympiads) & Boards (CBSE, ICSE & State). We are based in Bangalore and are known for our robust teaching methodology that provides consistently high results, year after year.
Ever since our journey began in 2012, we have been passionate about cultivating a nation of thinkers, researchers, and highly-talented individuals through our programmes that aim to educate the leaders of tomorrow. Our students develop strong foundational understandings and are able to achieve mastery in their subjects through 24x7 online and offline support.
Our mission is “to provide cost-effective world class education in order to create professionally superior manpower and to instil within students’s deep foundational values of good character to bring out Principle-Centred Leaders in the society.”

Our Faculty :
We believe that the success of the student hinges on the quality of the teacher. Know more about our expert faculty here:

1. Ankit D Tiwari
Alumni from IIT PALAKKAD, Completed his M.Sc in Chemistry in the year 2021. Worked as a Senior faculty of Chemistry at Yukti Institute, Mumbai. Working as a Senior faculty of Chemistry in Arjunaa Academy of Achievers. Have scored All India Rank 627 in IIT JAM examination. Research work: MATERIAL CHEMISTRY. Worked on a Non noble metal based catalyst for complete Ethylene oxidation.

2. Chirag S
I am currently serving as HOD, Physics Department at AAA. I have 4+ years of experience in communicating the beauty of Physics to students across Class X, XI and XII. I also enable students to be competent and confidence in applying the concepts in competitive exams in KVPY/JEE/NEET/KCET. I have had the fortune to work actively with research teams at ISRO, DRDO and BARC towards accomplishing technological intensive projects like Chandrayan-2, Missile Defense System (to name a few). I am pursuing Ph.D. at IISc, Bangalore. When not in laboratories or teaching you can catch me under the stars striking chords of a Beethoven composition or lost in the delightful plot of an Isaac Asimov novel.

3. MS Deeksha Sharma
Have completed Master degree in Mathematics (Specialization in Pure & Applied Mathematics). Qualified Gate Examination Twice - In year 2018, with AIR 1180 & In year 2019, with AIR 672. Worked as an IIT JEE Mathematics faculty in Gurukendram Institute, Kota, Rajasthan from 2018 - June 2021. Recently working as a IIT – JEE Mathematics faculty in Arjunaa Academy for Achievers. Completed the one Research paper on topic New Functional Taylor Series Method for Solving Fractional Riccatti Differential Equation. Has been awarded with a Gold Medal from Government College, Kota for Securing Higher Marks in M.Sc Mathematics Examination. Has been awarded with a Merit Certificate from University of Kota for Securing second Position in M.Sc Mathematics Examination.

4. Dheeraj Gupta
Alumnus from MNIT Jaipur. Completed his M-Tech in VLSI Design in the year 2021 from Department of Electronics & Communication Engineering. Working as a Senior Mathematics Faculty in Arjunaa Academy for Achievers. JEE Main Qualified twice in year 2014, 2015. GATE Qualified in Electronics & Communication Engineering in the year 2019 with All India Rank 3895. Area of Interest in Teaching – Coordinate Geometry, Calculus.

5. Hariom Kumar
Graduate from IIIT Kalyani in Computer Science. Have been interested in nature and natural phenomena since childhood. Hence, my love for physics and travelling. Have personally taught students who have obtained ranks of less than 1000. Guiding JEE and NEET aspirants for last 3 years.

6. Dr. Hemalatha
Working as Biology NEET FACULTY in ARJUNAA ACADEMY. Completed PhD from Bangalore University, botany department in 2015. Done M.Phil from Periyar University. Done MSc from Dharwad University. Worked as Visiting Scientist in Durban University, South Africa. Awarded as Best women scientist from Madhurai University.

7. Pramod Pandey
Alumni of NITW, completed his M.Tech. in Manufacturing Technology in 2018 and B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering in the year 2013. 6 years of teaching experience as an Assistant Professor in Mechanical Engineering Department in Presidency University, Bangalore and Rajiv Gandhi Technical University, Bhopal. 2 years of experience as a Doubt Solver at Unacademy. Published papers in the field of Automation in Manufacturing. AIR-1889 in Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering-2016. Qualified UPSC, Engineering Services Examination-2016. Qualified IOCL-2014, CIL-2014 and BEL-2014.

8. Dr. Hemalatha
Working as Biology NEET FACULTY in ARJUNAA ACADEMY. Completed PhD from Bangalore University, botany department in 2015. Done M.Phil from Periyar University. Done MSc from Dharwad University. Worked as Visiting Scientist in Durban University, South Africa. Awarded as Best women scientist from Madhurai University.

9. Ranjith Rajeev
I am as a Senior Physics Faculty at AAA. I have 2 years of experience in teaching JEE Mains, NEET, CET and foundation courses. I have high interest in physics and am sure that I can make learning physics interesting and engaging. Completed my MTech in IIT Kharagpur. I have cleared the 5 day SSB interview process for the position of Executive officer in Indian Navy, in my first attempt. Join me for learning physics.

10. Shreel S Prasad
Alumnus of BITS PILANI. Completed BTech in 2019 and Masters in Biotechnology in 2021. Worked on Anticancer properties of Camel Milk Protein “lactoferrin” as Masters thesis. Has done internship in Serum Institute of India, Pune – working on monoclonal bodies for Dengue and Polymeningitis. Silver medallist with scholarship in undergraduate program.

11. Subhashree V
B. Tech Biotechnology (Hons.) graduate from SASTRA Deemed to be University, Thanjavur. Working as a Senior Faculty Biology at Arjunaa Academy for Achievers.

12. Tati Usha Sailaja
Working as a Senior Faculty of Chemistry in “Arjunaa Academy of Achievers” (AAA), Bengaluru. Alumni of OSMANIA UNIVERSITY, Hyderabad, Telangana. Completed M.Sc. Chemistry in the year 2003, from Department of Chemistry, NIZAM College, Hyderabad, Telangana. Project on Ground Water Quality Analysis - Under the Guidance of Central Ground Water Board -Hyderabad. Has a teaching experience of 16 years for JEE/NEET Engineering/Undergraduate. My passion is teaching and making the young minds learn and understand chemistry in a better and easy way, makes my day interesting. Chemistry can be mysterious and making students develop critical thinking and logical reasoning to solve any chemistry problem makes me learn and teach more. I will be a student first surrounded by vibrant minds of my students who make me more efficient and perfect in my understanding towards life filled with chemistry.

13. Uthpala M
Working as Senior Biology Faculty in ‘Arjunaa Academy of Achievers’ (AAA), Bengaluru. Has teaching experience of 1 year for NEET/NTSE exams. Has 2 years of post-graduation teaching experience for regular as well as distance education courses in Department of Applied Zoology, Kuvempu University, Shivamogga. Alumnus of University of Mysore and Regional Institute of Education, Mysuru. Completed M.Sc. (Zoology) from University of Mysore and B.Sc.Ed (CBZ) from Regional Institute of Education, Mysuru. Qualified CTET and KSET (Life Science). Completed project on ‘Diversity of Ants around the different lakes of Mysuru’. Deeply interested to teach and learn Biology as it is required for one’s life.

14. K Abha Meenakshi
Alumni of National Institute of Technology, Rourkela. Currently a part of “Arjunaa Academy of Achievers” as a “Senior Mathematics Faculty”. Key Research Areas (At NIT Rourkela): Wavelets and their Path- connectivity-This is an area of Mathematics which deals with digital communications and signal transformations. Awarded as the “Best Thesis of the year” for the session 2020-2021. Delivered department and institute seminars on the following topics: “Riemann Integration”, “Wavelets with Composite Dilations” and “Proximal Theory of functions”. Generally, Mathematics is seen as one of the scariest subjects but it is a subject full of fun. I am inclined towards making the subject easier for the students to digest. Undoubtedly, it is the language of science so, being an integral part of science we must be aware of it.
